title: Shared rate-limit DB contract: rate_limit_buckets + consume_rate_limit_bucket

sha_binding.verified_source_note: The last non-proof commit on this branch, and the head every receipt in this bundle was captured against. It supersedes 97e2d9eb, the first implementation commit, after required verify's executable-wiring check correctly refused a test file reachable from no package script; the two regression suites now live at the lane's own apps/api/src/t1-proof-utv2-1811-*.test.ts paths and are wired into the root test:t1-proof:local script. The branch's remaining commits, ac47388c and 330e47d6, are lane manifest, sync metadata and PR binding written by ops:lane-start and by the lane-binding workflow. merge_sha is null pre-merge as the shared schema-v2 evidence contract requires (CEP-E7); post-merge-lane-close.yml binds it to the real merge commit.

verdict.statement: The submission outage was caused by a database contract that existed only in a code comment. consume_rate_limit_bucket is now defined by a governed migration, proven on real PostgreSQL 17 to reproduce InMemoryApiRateLimitStore semantics exactly, and proven to be unreachable by anon, authenticated and PUBLIC.

live_schema_parity.verdict: FAIL — 10 unauthorized findings, every one of them "missing_in_actual" for public.rate_limit_buckets and its columns, constraints and indexes.
live_schema_parity.why_not_pass: This gate diffs the repo migration set (expected) against the LIVE PRODUCTION database (actual). It reports objects that the repo declares and production does not yet have. UTV2-1811 creates a new relation and production DDL is not authorized, so the gate is correctly reporting a true difference. It cannot return PASS until the migration is applied to production.
live_schema_parity.not_a_merge_blocker: The required status job "Enforce parity (fail-closed)" (job 99933779832) SKIPPED on this feature-branch ref. This receipt blocks the CEP-E7 migration proof profile, not the merge gate. The four required status checks on main are Executor Result Validation, Merge Gate, P0 Protocol and verify.
live_schema_parity.precedent_measured: Every prior table-creating migration in this repo already exists in production: public.delivery_kill_switch (20260714120000), public.command_center_game_threads and public.command_center_delivery_mappings (20260803230000) all return non-null from to_regclass in zfzdnfwdarxucxtaojxm, while supabase_migrations.schema_migrations holds 127 rows stopping at version 20260801222906. Production DDL has therefore always preceded parity going green; this lane is not deviating from the established order, it is stopped at it awaiting authorization.
